title: Drag-handle section reorder
summary: Drag-handle column (teacher view, .no-print) on the worksheet preview that lets teachers reorder sections without regenerating. Uses @dnd-kit/core (already in deps for ClassPack + Year planner UI). Reorders the worksheet.sections array via the existing AppContext setter; the existing enforceSectionQuestionCounts validator no-ops on reorders since the count is unchanged. Optional '↓ Re-number questions' button to keep sequential numbers after reorder.
motivation: Universal polish ask. The current AI-edit-section flow regenerates the section content; teachers often just want to swap order — e.g. move the worked-example before Section A, or push the challenge to last.

in: client/src/components/WorksheetRenderer.tsx — wrap the section grid in DndContext (teacher view only)
client/src/contexts/AppContext.tsx — expose reorderSections(worksheetId, fromIndex, toIndex) action
client/src/lib/worksheet-renumber.ts (new, ~40 LoC) — pure helper that renumbers questionNumber on every q-* section in array order
Targeted vitest: reorder preserves all section content; renumber assigns 1..N to q-* sections in array order; non-q-* sections (LO, vocab-ref, reflection) keep questionNumber=undefined
out: Cross-worksheet drag (move a section from worksheet A to worksheet B) — deferred
Drag inside print preview (the print preview is a snapshot; reorder is on the editable preview only)

acceptance_criteria: Dragging a section to a new position updates the worksheet immediately (no flicker, no regeneration).
After reorder, the existing post-validator chain runs idempotently and produces the same warnings as before (modulo question-number reordering).
Renumber action sets questionNumber to 1..N over q-* sections in the new array order; running the post-validator chain after renumber produces no new warnings.
Drag is keyboard-accessible (Space to grab, arrow keys to move, Space to drop) per @dnd-kit's a11y defaults.
Print view is unchanged (drag-handle column has .no-print).
related: G3 — lesson archetypes (drag interacts cleanly with archetype-stamped sections; metadata.lessonArchetype is preserved)
G12 — answer key (regenerates after reorder using the same input array)
